name: qdoc preparation — option 1: small aggregates linked by events
description: Direction: small, focused aggregates coordinated by domain events, spread over child modules of the root qdocmanagement, each named for a domain concept. QDoc (documents) is small: title, type, number, archived flag, the lineage of its versions and the guard allowing one version in preparation and one in force. DocumentVersion (versions) is its own aggregate: status new/approved/published, a shared flag, its authors, reviewers and approvers, reviewed marks, the list of its files and the at-least-one-content-file rule. ContentFile (content) is its own aggregate so several authors edit concurrently: rich-text content with revision and history, comments on fragments, per-approver approvals that name the exact revision seen, and the lock after the first approval. Attachment (attachments) is its own aggregate with quarantine and an external scanner port; a failed scan makes the system remove it, record that in the activity list as the system's action and e-mail the author. Cross-aggregate outcomes travel as domain events implementing DocumentEvent: QDocCreated opens version 1 with an empty content file; FileApproved lets the version check whether every approver approved every file and become approved; every event is appended to the activity list (activity) and some trigger e-mails (notifications). People are assigned immediately: AssignmentPolicy checks the assigner (quality manager, or auditor on their own document), the assignee (exists, holds the role, active) and that the QDoc is not archived, against the user directory at that moment; there is no invitation step. Document numbers are <sequence>/<month>/<year> with a monthly per-organisation sequence, an optional organisation prefix and suffix, a demo prefix in demo instances and an auditor suffix. Gains: small transactions and concurrent editing and approval of different files; costs: eventual consistency between the version's file list and the file aggregates, and more building blocks and events. Out of scope: late correction between approval and publication (the approval lock is absolute here and a later change designs the correction), publication itself (it only reaches drafting as VersionPublished), employee sign-off, templates, AI reviewers, other approval strategies, per-section approval, deletion, and tracking attachment downloads. Attachment size limits are undecided pending research and not enforced.

description.value: Quality document management: the bounded context in which an organisation prepares, reviews and approves its quality documents (QDocs: procedures, guidelines, instructions, policies) under a controlled, fully audited process. This change covers drafting, from creating a QDoc until a version is approved and ready for publication. Its child modules are small, each around one aggregate or one concern, and talk to each other through domain events that all implement DocumentEvent.

description.value: A quality document: a package that functions as a whole, with a title, a type, a document number and one or more versions. description.value:
Creates a QDoc. Steps: load the requester from the UserDirectory and require an active quality manager or auditor; generate the number with DocumentNumberGenerator (auditor suffix when the requester acts as auditor, demo prefix in a demo instance); create the QDoc; check every person of the team with AssignmentPolicy against the new QDoc, the requester as assigner; save the QDoc. Any refused person refuses the whole creation. QDocCreated then makes the versions module open version 1 with one empty content file, makes notifications tell every quality manager, and is recorded in the activity list.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  Quality manager->>QDocService: createQDoc(command)
  QDocService->>UserDirectory: find(requester)
  QDocService->>DocumentNumberGenerator: generate(organisation, today, auditor)
  DocumentNumberGenerator->>MonthlyNumberSequence: next()
  QDocService->>QDoc: create(command, number)
  QDocService->>AssignmentPolicy: check(qdoc, requester, person, role) for each person
  QDocService->>QDocRepository: save(qdoc)
  QDoc-->>VersionService: QDocCreated
  VersionService->>DocumentVersion: open(version 1, team, one empty content file)
  DocumentVersion-->>ContentFileService: VersionOpened
  QDoc-->>Notifier: QDocCreated
  QDoc-->>ActivityRecorder: QDocCreated
```

```mermaid
  Quality manager->>QDocService: startNewVersion(command)
  QDocService->>QDocRepository: findById(qdocId)

  QDocService->>QDoc: startNewVersion(command)

  QDoc-->>VersionService: NewVersionStarted
  VersionService->>DocumentVersion: open(version n, team, copies of previous files)
  DocumentVersion-->>ContentFileService: VersionOpened
  DocumentVersion-->>AttachmentService: VersionOpened
  QDoc-->>Notifier: NewVersionStarted
```

description.value:
An assigned author uploads a PDF to a new version. Checks the author and the version, stores the bytes, creates the quarantined attachment, saves it and requests a scan. AttachmentUploaded registers it on the version as inactive.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  Author->>AttachmentService: upload(versionId, file, author)
  AttachmentService->>DocumentVersionRepository: findById(versionId)
  AttachmentService->>AttachmentStorage: store(file)
  AttachmentService->>Attachment: upload(...)
  AttachmentService->>AttachmentRepository: save(attachment)
  AttachmentService->>AttachmentScanner: requestScan(fileId, stored)
  Attachment-->>VersionService: AttachmentUploaded
```

description.value:
Receives a scan result from the scanner adapter, applies it to the attachment and saves it. On a failure it deletes the stored bytes; AttachmentRemovedAfterFailedScan then drops the file from the version, is recorded in the activity list as the system's action and makes notifications e-mail the author.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  AttachmentScanner-->>AttachmentService: onScanCompleted(result)
  AttachmentService->>AttachmentRepository: findById(fileId)
  AttachmentService->>Attachment: completeScan(result)
  AttachmentService->>AttachmentRepository: save(attachment)
  AttachmentService->>AttachmentStorage: delete(stored) when failed
  Attachment-->>VersionService: AttachmentVerified or AttachmentRemovedAfterFailedScan
  Attachment-->>ActivityRecorder: AttachmentRemovedAfterFailedScan
  Attachment-->>Notifier: AttachmentRemovedAfterFailedScan
```
